# Runtime format outliner provenance

The formatting engine uses vendored nanoprintf v0.8.0 at commit
`115c91627d005a2370d5627defc64750fcf65a71` under the 0BSD/Unlicense terms.
These entry points provide the AVP interface's register-outlined parser,
scratch write, argument cursor, stack guard, and Firebloom tuple contracts
around that public formatter.

Upstream: https://github.com/charlesnicholson/nanoprintf/tree/115c91627d005a2370d5627defc64750fcf65a71
